carriers.name: USS Carl Vinson
carriers.evidenceText: The label “USS Carl Vinson (CVN-70)” shares a yellow diamond with USS Makin Island immediately offshore of California.
carriers.rationale: Estimated from the diamond adjacent to the California coast; positioned offshore rather than on the coastal landmass.

carriers.name: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
carriers.evidenceText: A yellow diamond appears beneath the “USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69)” label over the eastern United States.
carriers.rationale: The stylized marker is drawn inland, so it was re-anchored to the nearby carrier port at Norfolk; the map does not support a more precise visual position.

carriers.name: USS George H.W. Bush
carriers.evidenceText: “George H.W. Bush CSG” is one of three labels associated with a single yellow diamond southeast of the Arabian Peninsula.
carriers.rationale: The shared diamond is visually offshore in the western Arabian Sea, east-southeast of Oman.

carriers.name: USS George Washington
carriers.evidenceText: “George Washington CSG” is listed directly above the shared yellow diamond southeast of the Arabian Peninsula.
carriers.rationale: No separate carrier diamond is shown, so the same offshore Arabian Sea marker is used.

carriers.name: USS Abraham Lincoln
carriers.locationName: Central Indian Ocean southwest of India
carriers.evidenceText: The “Abraham Lincoln CSG” label is immediately above a distinct yellow diamond southwest of India.
carriers.rationale: The diamond is clearly over open water in the central Indian Ocean, south-southwest of India.

carriers.name: USS Nimitz
carriers.evidenceText: Blue USS Nimitz (CVN 68) silhouette appears beside the Norfolk, VA port marker.
carriers.rationale: Placed pierside in Norfolk harbor, with a slight berth offset from the other Norfolk carriers.

carriers.name: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
carriers.locationName: Western North Atlantic east of Virginia
carriers.evidenceText: Orange USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN 69) silhouette is shown immediately east of the Norfolk group.
carriers.rationale: The training-colored marker is offshore from Norfolk; the coordinate follows that visual placement and remains in open Atlantic water.

carriers.name: USS Carl Vinson
carriers.evidenceText: Orange USS Carl Vinson (CVN 70) silhouette is plotted adjacent to and east of the Pearl Harbor, HI marker.
carriers.rationale: Placed in open Pacific water close to the Hawaii-associated marker rather than at a land centroid.

carriers.name: USS Theodore Roosevelt
carriers.evidenceText: Blue USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71) silhouette is connected visually with the San Diego, CA port marker.
carriers.rationale: The blue at-port status supports placement in San Diego Bay.

carriers.name: USS Abraham Lincoln
carriers.evidenceText: Green USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72) silhouette is the easternmost deployed carrier marker in the northern Indian Ocean portion of the map.
carriers.rationale: The marker is southeast of India and east of the other deployed carriers, so it is placed over open water in the Bay of Bengal.

carriers.name: USS George Washington
carriers.evidenceText: Green USS George Washington (CVN 73) silhouette appears in the Arabian Sea below the George H.W. Bush marker.
carriers.rationale: Placed at the adjacent ship symbol over open Arabian Sea water, preserving its north-south separation from CVN-77.

carriers.name: USS John C. Stennis
carriers.evidenceText: Red USS John C. Stennis (CVN 74) silhouette appears within the map's Norfolk, VA maintenance group.
carriers.rationale: Placed at a Hampton Roads shipyard berth consistent with the explicit port grouping and maintenance status.

carriers.name: USS Harry S. Truman
carriers.evidenceText: Red USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75) silhouette is included in the Norfolk, VA maintenance cluster.
carriers.rationale: Placed pierside in Norfolk harbor, slightly separated from the other carriers in the same port.

carriers.name: USS Ronald Reagan
carriers.evidenceText: Red USS Ronald Reagan (CVN 76) silhouette is attached to the Bremerton, WA port marker.
carriers.rationale: Placed at the Bremerton naval waterfront, an explicitly named port location.

carriers.name: USS George H.W. Bush
carriers.evidenceText: Green USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77) silhouette is the northernmost deployed carrier marker near Oman and Pakistan.
carriers.rationale: Placed over open water in the Gulf of Oman at the marker's visual position, north of CVN-73.

carriers.name: USS Gerald R. Ford
carriers.evidenceText: Red USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) silhouette appears beside the Norfolk, VA port marker.
carriers.rationale: The maintenance-colored carrier is placed pierside in Norfolk harbor.

carriers.name: USS Carl Vinson
carriers.evidenceText: The label “USS Carl Vinson (CVN-70)” shares a yellow diamond with USS Makin Island west of Southern California.
carriers.rationale: Placed on the yellow diamond adjacent to the grouped label, over Pacific waters west of California.

carriers.name: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
carriers.locationName: Western Atlantic off the U.S. East Coast
carriers.evidenceText: The label “USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69)” shares a yellow diamond with USS Kearsarge east of the United States.
carriers.rationale: Placed on the adjacent offshore diamond in the western Atlantic rather than on the nearby North American landmass.

carriers.name: USS George H.W. Bush
carriers.evidenceText: “George H.W. Bush CSG” appears in a three-unit label above a yellow diamond in the Arabian Sea.
carriers.rationale: The shared diamond lies over open water between the Arabian Peninsula and India.

carriers.name: USS George Washington
carriers.evidenceText: “George Washington CSG” appears with George H.W. Bush CSG and Boxer ARG above the same yellow diamond.
carriers.rationale: Assigned the shared Arabian Sea marker; no separate George Washington diamond is shown.

carriers.name: USS Abraham Lincoln
carriers.evidenceText: The label “Abraham Lincoln CSG” is directly above a yellow diamond between the Malay Peninsula and Borneo.
carriers.rationale: Placed on the adjacent diamond over the southern South China Sea, west of Borneo.
